remarks: Luxury, location, and convenience await you in this stunning 1BR, 1BTH loft-style condo in the heart of Downtown Stamford. This one-of-a-kind corner unit features wall-to-wall windows and high ceilings that flood the space with natural light, creating a modern and elegant atmosphere. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances and a breakfast bar, perfect for casual dining and entertaining. The beautifully updated bathroom includes a walk-in shower, modern vanity and linen closet blending style and functionality, while the spacious bedroom has an oversized walk-in closet for ample storage. With engineered wood flooring throughout, new window treatments, and central air, this home is ready for you to move right in! Located in The Biltmore, a premier high-rise condominium, residents enjoy a 24-hour concierge, fitness center, shuttle service, community room, laundry room, storage, 4th-flr courtyard, dry cleaning, and a pet-friendly environment. Secure garage parking is available for $115/mo per car. Conveniently located near I-95, Metro-North, Merritt Parkway, and just steps from the vibrant Bedford Street and Pickleball America, one of the largest indoor pickleball venues in the US, this condo offers the best of city living in the heart of Stamford!
